evals.name: pr-tests-oversized
evals.prompt: Break down bead zr-fix.7 ('Write automated tests for the toolchain-selection logic') — spans 4 source files; child of PR bead zr-fix (repo ZR-Private/ziprecruiter, pr_number 93270, branch phillipg.JVM-357.add-toolchain, base main); worker pool consumes it. Produce the breakdown plan.
evals.expected_output: Split into multiple single-file/single-module children, each labeled worker-ready, each self-contained with injected PR context (branch/repo/pr_number) and a done/acceptance gate.

assertions.text: Splits the oversized bead into >= 2 child beads
Each child is scoped to a single file or module (single-context sized)
Leaf beads are labeled worker-ready (PR/worker consumer)
Shared context (branch/repo/pr_number) is injected into each child rather than left as a lookup
Each child description is self-contained (no 'see parent for context')
Each child states an explicit acceptance/done gate

evals.name: ccpool-nonpr-generalize
evals.prompt: Break down 'ccpool needs 3 new capabilities (N1 env injection, N2 launch flags, N3 list --json)' for a ccpool specialist (label: ccpool), NOT the PR worker pool. No PR/branch — mainline infra in packages/ccpool/. Produce the breakdown plan.
evals.expected_output: Three children (one per capability), each labeled 'ccpool' (NOT worker-ready), no fabricated PR/branch/pr_number fields, file paths injected per child, acceptance gate per child.

assertions.text: Leaf beads are labeled 'ccpool', NOT worker-ready
Does NOT fabricate PR / branch / pr_number / merge-request fields (none exist for this work)
Splits into ~3 children, one per capability (N1/N2/N3)
Injects the concrete file paths (cmd/ccpool/new.go etc.) into each child
Each child states an explicit acceptance/done gate

evals.name: already-right-sized
evals.prompt: Decide whether/how to break down bead zr-bug.3 ('Fix the off-by-one in pagination offset at refresh.go:142') — single function, single file; child of PR bead zr-bug; worker pool consumes it. Produce the plan.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes it is already a single-context leaf; does NOT split into children; arms the single bead worker-ready.

assertions.text: Does NOT split the bead into children (recognizes an already-right-sized leaf)
